entities.summary: Robert Charles Joseph Emile Jacquinot de Besange, SJ, also known as Jacquinot de Besange and in China as Rao Jia-ju, was a French Jesuit who set up a successful model of safety zones that saved over half-a-million Chinese people during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
